title: THE PHASE 2 GATE: validate_portal_equivalence.py passes — layer compositing and L2 trick verified
implementation_notes: Created parallax_engine/synthetic_renderer.py to handle the synthetic test scene format
Projection: scale = P / (P - z); z=0→scale=1.0, z=200→scale=4/3≈1.333
Layer compositing: default layers in declaration order, then above_mask layers on top
Circular mask: alpha_inside=0 means layer not drawn inside circle (L0 shows through)
L2 trick (§2.4): render_pass='above_mask' layers paint AFTER mask compositing, ignoring mask
PNG frames chosen over H.264 MP4 to avoid lossy compression artifacts exceeding max_abs_error=80 threshold
Pixel-identical to analytical reference: SSIM=1.0, MAE=0.0, MaxAE=0
